stem.en: Mina has 24 pens. She puts the same number in each packet, with 6 pens in each. How many packets does she fill? Which step fits?

text.en: 24 x 6, because the word "each" always means multiply
24 / 6, because the pens are shared into equal groups
24 - 6, because some pens go into a packet
24 + 6, because more packets are being filled

explanation.en: Here 24 pens are shared into equal groups of 6, so the step is 24 / 6 = 4 packets. The word "each" can point to multiply or to divide. The words and numbers around it decide which.
